chunks: Hariz narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

The milk of a Jewish, Christian, or Magian woman is more beloved to me than the milk of a child born from zina. And he did not consider there to be any harm in the milk of a child born from zina if the master of the bondwoman, with whom the immoral act was committed with the bondwoman, renders it permissible.

key_terms.فِي حِلٍّ: made lawful or treated as permitted
key_terms.لَبَنُ: milk, in the context of breastfeeding and suckling

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about using the milk of a child born from zina compared with that of a Jewish, Christian, or Magian woman?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling related to breastfeeding and the relative preference between different sources of milk. It indicates disfavor toward the milk of a child born from zina, while also stating that no harm is seen in it under a specified condition involving the bondwoman's master.
